_source: Fitbit Web API (api.fitbit.com) documented response shapes for a US-locale (en_US) account — same endpoints as fitbit.recorded.json. Fitbit selects the unit system of a response from the Accept-Language request header: `en_US` => United States, `en_GB` => United Kingdom, none of these or not provided => Metric. The connector sends no Accept-Language header, so summary.distances[].distance is in KILOMETERS and body.log.weight[].weight is in KILOGRAMS, although profile.user.distanceUnit / weightUnit = `en_US`. See https://dev.fitbit.com/build/reference/web-api/developer-guide/application-design/#Localization and https://dev.fitbit.com/build/reference/web-api/body/get-weight-log/ (weight: 'in the unit system that corresponds to the Accept-Language header provided or if not provided in metric').
_why: US-profile variant. Replayed through syncHealthConnectorData({token:{provider:'fitbit'}}) to assert the profile unit does NOT change the stored values: 8.05 km => 8050 m and 68.04 kg => 68.04 kg. A profile-unit conversion would store 12955.2 m and 30.86 kg.
